The '''Invasion of Lorrd''' was a conflict during the early stages of the [[Kanz Disorders/Legends|Kanz Disorders]] which pitted the [[Myrialites]] of the [[Argazdan Redoubt]] against the [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdians]]. The battle saw the conquest of Lorrd and the mass enslavement of the entire Lorrdian species for the next three hundred years until they were liberated by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]/[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces in [[3670 BBY]].

==History==
During the [[Mandalorian Wars]], the [[Argazdan/Legends|Argazdans]] of [[Argazda/Legends|Argazda]] came under the influence of a secessionist movement known as the [[Myrialites]] led by [[Governor/Legends|Provisional Governor]] [[Myrial]]. Perceiving the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as "corrupt and faithless", they launched a violent revolt and annexed the [[Kanz sector/Legends|Kanz sector]]; claiming some of it as the [[Argazdan Redoubt]]. In the ensuing conflict, the Myrialites invaded and annexed several planets within the region including the [[Amaltanna/Legends|Amaltannans]], whom they proceed to enslave.<ref name="Hyperspace" />

The Lorrdians supported the [[Amaltannan resistance]], earning the ire of Myrial who ordered that they be conquered and enslaved as well. The Argazdan military fleet orbitally bombarded the Lorrdian homeworld of [[Lorrd/Legends|Lorrd]]; devastating major centers like Frezen and New Shallos. This resulted in enormous casaulties among the civilian population and the survivors fled to the sparsely-populated province of [[Kinyov]] which had escaped the naval bombardment.<ref name="Hyperspace" />

However, they were quickly rounded up by Argazdan ground troops and [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]]. Kinyov's capital of [[Qatamer]] became a center of slaving operations and the headquarters of the Myrialites rulers. The enslaved Lorrdians were forbidden by their masters from communicating with each other. As a result, they were forced to develop a system of subtle gestures, facial expressions, and body postures to talk to each other known as [[kinetic communication]].<ref name="Hyperspace" />

The Myrialites established a totalitarian system that would last for three hundred years. Any attempt made by the Galactic Republic and the Jedi to end the disorders was cut short by the [[Mandalorian Wars]] followed by the more devastating [[Jedi Civil War|Jedi]] and [[Sith Civil War]]s. Around [[3670 BBY]], the Lorrdian [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Mari-Elan Nora]] led a joint Jedi and Republic task force to liberate the Kanz sector. Despite dogged resistance from the Argazdans, the Jedi and Republic forces defeated the Myrialites.<ref name="Hyperspace" />
